description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Contacts' module in SuiteCRM. It defines the 'ContactTest' class which extends SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase, and includes various test methods validating the creation, attribute setting, relationship handling, query generation, and other behaviors of the 'Contact' bean/object.
